caption:
You keep getting knocked down alone. What if you were never meant to hold the line by yourself — and the real enemy isn't even inside you? (Galatians 5:1 devotional)

"Stand firm" is a command in the plural — the line holds when believers lock in together, not when one exhausted soldier tries to hold it alone. And the real enemy isn't just your own weakness but the powers pressing in from outside; that's why God hands you armor, not solo willpower — Christ's righteousness guards your heart and His peace steadies your stance. You're not the last one standing; you're braced in the line He set you in.
